title: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme
about: The University of Sydney's Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme considers international students with an unconditional offer automatically, without a separate application. Round 1 for Semester 2, 2027 entry closes on 15 February 2027, with later rounds in March and May 2027.
requirements: International students holding an unconditional offer from the University of Sydney by the round closing date
No separate application required; eligible students are automatically considered
